ruler_origin: The clear perimeter of the registered seven-light aperture. For each level, concentric offsets were projected to the original photograph in tenths of a metre on both sides. Distant trees and rain pipes hide parts of the boundary.

rake_coping.evidence: The brick course along the left rake can be seen independently in the 2018 close public view and on the 2017 full frontage. The two datum rays through the edge diverge rapidly at this obliquity; the depth is a conditional section.
